description_sq:
Shes apartament totalisht te arreduar perballe Spitalit Amerikan 3, ndodhet ne kompleksin Tirana Golden Park.
Apartamenti pozicionohet ne katin e 7 te objektit, i pajisur me dy ashensor.
Orientimi prones eshte jug-perendim, me pamje te hapur drite diell pergjate gjithe dites.
Cilesia e arredimit bashkekohore.
Inverter A+ ne secilen dhome.
Per nje vizite ne prone ose informacione te tjera lutem kontaktoni ne numrin tim.
description_en: I am selling a fully furnished apartment in front of the American Hospital 3, located in the Tirana Golden Park complex. The apartment is located on the 7th floor of the building, equipped with two elevators. The orientation of the property is south-west, with an open view of sunlight throughout the day. Quality contemporary furnishings. Inverter A+ in each room. For a visit to the property or other information, please contact me at my number.
